name: AI Auto-reference
description: Automatically sets or suggests references to other content entities in the site.

suggests.drupal/field_widget_actions: Enables AI suggestion buttons directly within entity reference field widgets on the node edit form.

project_description: AI Auto-reference uses a Large Language Model (through the drupal/ai module's provider abstraction) to suggest or automatically fill entity-reference fields on node forms, pointing content at related nodes or taxonomy terms drawn from the site's own existing content. Per node bundle, a site builder maps an entity-reference field to a rendered view mode (the content sent to the model) and an ai_prompt entity (the instruction). At edit time content editors get suggestions two ways: a 'Generate references with AI' button next to Save that runs a Batch and shows an apply/review form, or an inline Field Widget Action button on the reference widget itself (requires the optional field_widget_actions module) that opens a modal of checkboxes/radios to insert. Candidate targets are restricted to the values the current user is actually allowed to reference. It ships two default prompts (single- and multiple-suggestion) and an auto_reference prompt type, and can auto-apply high/medium relevance suggestions without a review step. The AI provider and model are configured through AI core, so any supported chat model can be used.
